purpose: night autonomy through night with 10kWh battery and 300W night cooling load
code_or_query:
import numpy as np
dt=0.25
t=np.arange(0,24,dt)
# sun 6am-6pm bell shape PV kW for 2.4kWp
PV=np.maximum(0,np.sin(np.pi*(t-6)/12))*2.4*0.75
# cooling load: 800W day avg, 300W night
load=np.where((t>=6)&(t<=18),0.8,0.3)
E_batt=10.0*0.8  # usable at 80% DoD, start full usable
soc=[E_batt]
for i in range(len(t)):
    E_batt=min(8.0, max(0, E_batt+(PV[i]-load[i])*dt))
    soc.append(E_batt)
print(f"min usable remaining kWh: {min(soc):.2f}")
print(f"end usable kWh: {soc[-1]:.2f}")
print(f"PV daily kWh: {PV.sum()*dt:.2f} load daily kWh: {load.sum()*dt:.2f}")
